description: A true taste of coastal New England, this Maine Lobster Roll recipe features succulent, fresh lobster meat lightly dressed and served in a toasted, buttered bun. It's a simple yet incredibly satisfying dish that highlights the natural sweetness of premium lobster. Perfect for a summer gathering or a special treat, this classic roll brings the essence of Maine right to your table.

ingredients.item: New England style hot dog buns

instructions.title: Prepare the Lobster Meat
instructions.text: Ensure your cooked lobster meat is thoroughly chilled and roughly chopped into bite-sized pieces. Pat it dry with paper towels to remove any excess moisture, which helps the dressing adhere better. Place the prepared lobster in a medium mixing bowl.

instructions.title: Make the Dressing
instructions.text: In a separate small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, finely diced celery, fresh lemon juice, minced fresh chives, salt, and black pepper. Whisk these ingredients together until well combined and smooth, creating a creamy and zesty dressing.

instructions.title: Combine Lobster and Dressing
instructions.text: Gently add the prepared dressing to the chopped lobster meat in the mixing bowl. Using a rubber spatula, carefully fold the dressing into the lobster, ensuring all the pieces are lightly coated without mashing the delicate meat. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Prepare the Buns
instructions.text: Melt the unsalted butter in a small saucepan or microwave. Brush the outside surfaces of the New England style hot dog buns generously with the melted butter. This butter will create a golden, crispy exterior when toasted.

instructions.title: Toast the Buns
instructions.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-low heat. Place the buttered buns, split-side down, in the hot skillet. Toast for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and lightly crispy. Be careful not to burn them.

instructions.title: Assemble the Lobster Rolls
instructions.text: Remove the chilled lobster mixture from the refrigerator. Open each toasted bun and spoon a generous amount of the dressed lobster meat into the center. Mound the lobster high for an authentic look.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Serve your authentic Maine Lobster Rolls immediately, perhaps with a side of potato chips, coleslaw, or a dill pickle spear. Enjoy the fresh, briny taste of New England.

tips: For the most authentic experience, always use fresh, high-quality lobster meat. If you're cooking whole lobsters, steam them for 7-10 minutes per pound, then chill completely before picking the meat.

The key to a great Maine Lobster Roll is a light touch with the dressing. You want to enhance the lobster's natural flavor, not overpower it. Use just enough mayonnaise to bind the ingredients and add creaminess.
Serve your lobster rolls chilled for the classic Maine style. They pair wonderfully with a crisp, cold beer or a glass of dry white wine, and a simple side like kettle chips or a light green salad.
